title: The completed principal coefficient sequence is short exact
statement: For any field k, prime ℓ, finite extension E/Q_ℓ and n≥0 on s=Spec k, multiplication by the constant uniformizer power π^(n+1) on the underlying additive sheaf of completed integral coefficients, followed by the actual finite projection, forms a short exact sequence. Multiplication is the final-section multiplication of [lem-pod-derived-reduction-sheaf-resolution-independence] along the actual pointIntegralSectionMap.

source.place: Coefficient sheaves and finite constant quotients, Tags 093J--093M; original item step 1 and the finite-level divisibility argument

proof.text: Naturality of constant scalars identifies final-section multiplication on every site object with the constant uniformizer power. The finite projection kills it, since π^(n+1) belongs to its defining ideal.

source.place: Coefficient sheaves and finite constant quotients, Tags 093J--093M; original item step 1 and the finite-level divisibility argument

proof.text: The projection kernel is made of multiples of this power by the completed projection divisibility theorem. Multiplication is sectionwise injective by completed uniformizer regularity.

source.place: Coefficient sheaves and finite constant quotients, Tags 093J--093M; original item step 1 and the finite-level divisibility argument

proof.text: The constant quotient ring map is surjective and has a set-theoretic section. Constant set sheafification therefore makes it surjective on each object. It factors through the completed projection by the limit-lift identity, so that projection is sectionwise onto. Objectwise exactness gives presheaf exactness via evaluation and homology; the faithful additive sheaf inclusion reflects short exactness.

theorem pointPrincipalReductionCoefficients (k : Type u) [Field k]
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E]
    [Algebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E] (n : ℕ) :
    let U := ProEt.mk (𝟙 (Spec (.of k)))
    let O := completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l E (Spec (.of k))
    let μ := sectionMultiplication O U
      (MorphismProperty.Over.mkIdTerminal @WeaklyEtale (Spec (.of k)))
      (pointIntegralSectionMap l E k
        (ULift.up (Padic.coefficientExtensionUniformizer l E) ^ (n + 1)))
    let φ := (sheafCompose (ProEt.topology (Spec (.of k)))
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u + 1} RingCat.{u + 1} ⋙
        forget₂ RingCat.{u + 1} AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})).map
      (completedIntegralCommRingProjectionUnrestricted l E (Spec (.of k)) n)
    ∃ hz : μ ≫ φ = 0, (ShortComplex.mk μ φ hz).ShortExact
